statement.name: PollMessageQueue
statement.sql:
BEGIN TRANSACTION set nocount on; update top() mail_dispatchermessagequeue
where MessageQueued is NULL and PollerIdentifier is NULL; set nocount off; select MessageId, ISNULL(MessageQueued,0) MessageQueued, ISNULL(MessageDetailPopulated,0) MessageDetailPopulated from mail_dispatchermessagequeue
MessageQueued is NULL
COMMIT TRANSACTION

statement.name: GetMessengerQueue
statement.sql:
set nocount on; update top() mail_dispatchermessagequeue
MessageQueued = 1
where MessageQueued is NULL and PollerIdentifier is NULL; set nocount off; SELECT cast(q.MessageId as varchar(36)) as MessageId, case isnull(luUser.userid,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') when '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then isnull(ext.email,'') else isnull(luUser.email,'') end as UserEmailAddress, case isnull(luUser.userid,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') when '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then isnull(ext.firstname,'') else isnull(luUser.firstname,'') end as UserFirstName, case isnull(luUser.userid,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') when '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then isnull(ext.lastname,'') else isnull(luUser.lastname,'') end as UserLastName, userLog.SystemBased,statement userLog.TypeOfUser TypeOfReciept, body.BodyType BodyTypeCode, isnull(luUser.Digest,0) DigestFlag, isnull(luUser.Digest,0) PreferenceTimeTypeCode, msgLog.ReceiptToList, msgLog.receiptCCList, msgLog.receiptBCCList, msg.SenderId, isnull(SenUser.Email,'') SenderEmailAddress, isnull(SenUser.firstName,'') SenderFirstName, isnull(SenUser.LastName,'') SenderLastName, msg.Subject, msg.MessageDate, msg.Attachments, isnull(msg.SendAlertFlag,1) SendAlertFlag, isnull(msg.SendContentFlag,1) SendContentFlag, body.Body FROM mail_dispatchermessagequeue q inner join mail_message msg on q.messageid = msg.messageid inner join mail_messageLog msgLog on msg.messageid = msgLog.messageid left outer join lu_users SenUser on msgLog.userid = SenUser.Userid inner join mail_body body on msg.messageid = body.messageid inner join mail_UserLog userLog on msg.messageid = userLog.messageid left outer join lu_users luUser on userlog.Userid = luUser.userid left outer join Mail_ExternalUsers ext on userlog.Userid = ext.ExternalUserId
userLog.TypeOfUser <> 'From'

statement.name: GetUser
statement.sql: select FirstName, LastName, UserName, email from Lu_Users

statement.name: GetStandardMessagesByContext
statement.sql:
BEGIN TRANSACTION select cast(a.StandardMessageId as varchar(36)) StandardMessageId, Subject, Body, BodyType,statementName,componentName, DefinitionFile, RelationshipLocation from mail_StandardContext as a inner join mail_standardMessage as b on a.StandardMessageId=b.StandardMessageId
; select FileName as FileName, cast(MSMA.AttachmentId as varchar(36)) as AttachmentId, cast(MSC.StandardMessageId as varchar(36)) UniqueStandardMessageId From mail_StandardContext as MSC inner join mail_standardMessage as MSM on MSC.StandardMessageId=MSM.StandardMessageId inner join Mail_StandardMessageAttachments MSMA on MSMA.StandardMessageId=MSM.StandardMessageId inner join dm_attachment DMA on DMA.Attachmentid = MSMA.AttachmentId
COMMIT TRANSACTION

statement.name: GetMailAddressDetails
statement.sql: select ReceiptToList AS 'To', ReceiptCCList AS 'CC', ReceiptBCCList AS 'Bcc' FROM mail_message_context MMC join mail_message MM on MM.MessageId = MMC.MessageId join Mail_Body MB on MB.MessageId = MM.MessageId join mail_messagelog MML on MML.MessageId = MM.MessageId

statement.name: GetUnreadMessageCount
statement.sql: select count(*) from Mail_UserLog with(NOLOCK) where UserId = '' and TypeOfUser = 'To' and MessageRead is null and MessageDeleted is null

statement.name: QueueMessage
statement.sql:
update mail_dispatchermessagequeue set MessageQueued = 1,LastUpdateDate = current_timestamp
MessageQueued is NULL

CleanUp
statement.sql: update mail_dispatchermessagequeue set MessageQueued = NULL, PollerIdentifier = NULL

statement.name: GetMailMessageDetails
statement.sql: select u.email AS 'From', MML.ReceiptToList AS 'To', MML.ReceiptCCList AS 'CC', MML.ReceiptBCCList AS 'Bcc', Subject, Body FROM mail_message_context MMC join mail_message MM on MM.MessageId = MMC.MessageId join Mail_Body MB on MB.MessageId = MM.MessageId join mail_messagelog MML on MML.MessageId = MM.MessageId inner join lu_users u on u.userid = MML.userid

statement.name: GetEmailDetails
statement.sql:
select MD.MessageDetailId, MD.MessageId, MD.UserId, MD.UserEmailAddress, MD.UserFirstName, MD.UserLastName, MD.SystemBased, MD.TypeOfReciept, MD.BodyTypeCode, MD.DigestFlag, MD.PreferenceTimeTypeCode, dbo.ufn_GetEmailfromUserName(MD.ReceiptToList) as ReceiptToList, dbo.ufn_GetEmailfromUserName(MD.receiptCCList) as receiptCCList, dbo.ufn_GetEmailfromUserName(MD.receiptBCCList) as receiptBCCList, --MD.SenderEmailAddress, dbo.ufn_GetEmailfromUserName(MD.SenderId) as SenderEmailAddress, MD.SenderFirstName, MD.SenderLastName, MD.Subject, MD.SenderId, MD.MessageDate, MD.Attachments, MD.SendAlertFlag, MD.SendContentFlag, MD.CreatedDate, MD.LastUpdateDate, MB.Body MailBody from Mail_DispatcherMessageDetails MD, mail_body MB
MD.messageId = MB.messageId

statement.name: ArchiveMessageDetails
statement.sql:
BEGIN TRANSACTION insert into hist_mail_dispatchermessagedetails (MessageDetailId, MessageId, UserId, UserEmailAddress, SystemBased, TypeOfReciept, BodyTypeCode, DigestFlag, PreferenceTimeTypeCode, ReceiptToList, receiptCCList, receiptBCCList, SenderId, Subject, MessageDate, Attachments, SendAlertFlag, SendContentFlag, SenderEmailAddress, SenderFirstName, SenderLastName, UserFirstName, UserLastName, SentDate) select MessageDetailId, MessageId, UserId,
UserEmailAddress,
SystemBased, TypeOfReciept, BodyTypeCode, DigestFlag, PreferenceTimeTypeCode, ReceiptToList, receiptCCList, receiptBCCList, SenderId, Subject, MessageDate, Attachments, SendAlertFlag, SendContentFlag, SenderEmailAddress, SenderFirstName, SenderLastName, UserFirstName, UserLastName, current_timestamp from mail_dispatchermessagedetails
; delete from Mail_DispatcherMessageDetails
; delete from mail_dispatchermessagequeue
COMMIT TRANSACTION

statement.name: GetAttachmentDetails
statement.sql:
select dm.FileLocation, dm.FileName, upper(dm.fileExtension) fileExtension, dm.PhysicalFileName, dm.FileDescription from dm_attachment dm inner join ( select dm.attachmentid as attachmentid , max(dm.AttachmentInstance) as AttachmentInstance from mail_attachment ma inner join dm_attachment dm on ma.attachmentid = dm.attachmentid
group by dm.attachmentid ) B on dm.attachmentid = B.attachmentid AND dm.AttachmentInstance = B.AttachmentInstance
